description:
Born an alpha, entertainment agency CEO Chae Jae-woon suddenly becomes an omega after eating a peach.
Having lost more than half his assets in a divorce settlement, Jae-woon is thrilled when rising star Lee San-woo signs an exclusive contract with him - like a winning lottery ticket walking through his door ... But his joy doesn’t last long.

*“President, can I just sleep with you once?”*

San-woo turns out to be not only scandal-prone but also shamelessly lusting after his divorced boss, propositioning him every time their eyes meet.

*“Don’t you dare put it in! I’m allergic to alphas!”  
“Yeah, right.”*

Now an omega with the added curse of alpha allergy, Jae-woon desperately tries to fend off San-woo’s relentless advances…
